title: 聊聊健康习惯
subtitle: Keeping fit and healthy
examTip: 在PET口语Part 1中，考官通常会问关于你保持健康的方式，比如你常做什么运动、饮食上有什么好习惯。你回答时需要用完整句，并给出理由或例子，自然而然会用到一般现在时（如I go running）、现在完成时（如I've started eating more vegetables）或比较级（如It's healthier than junk food）。Part 2中，你会看到一张彩色照片，要描述人们在运动或吃东西的场景。这时你通常会用到现在进行时来描述动作（如They are playing football），用maybe或probably推测心情（如They probably feel happy），以及用连接词because、so、but等使你的独白更连贯。注意不要只蹦单词，而要试着把句子连起来说。

templates.en: I usually ___ to keep fit.
templates.zh: 说自己的健康习惯

templates.en: I like doing ___ because it makes me ___.
templates.zh: 说明喜欢某项运动的原因

templates.en: I try to eat ___ every day.
templates.zh: 介绍日常饮食中的健康食物

templates.en: I think ___ is important for health.
templates.zh: 表达对健康重要因素的看法

part1.en: Do you do any sports or exercise to stay healthy?
part1.zh: 你会做运动或锻炼来保持健康吗？

part1.en: Yes, I usually go jogging in the park near my home three times a week. It helps me relax and keeps me fit.
part1.zh: 是的，我通常每周三次在离家不远的公园慢跑。这让我放松，也能让我保持健康。

part1.en: What do you usually eat to stay healthy?
part1.zh: 你通常吃什么来保持健康？

part1.en: I try to eat a lot of fruit and vegetables every day, and I drink plenty of water instead of sugary drinks.
part1.zh: 我尽量每天吃很多水果和蔬菜，而且多喝水，少喝含糖饮料。

part1.en: Have you made any changes to your lifestyle recently to be healthier?
part1.zh: 你最近为了更健康，改变了什么生活习惯吗？

part1.en: Yes, I've started going to bed earlier because I want to get enough sleep. I also walk more instead of taking the bus.
part1.zh: 是的，我开始早睡了，因为我想保证充足睡眠。我也多走路，少坐公交车。

part1.en: Which do you think is better for health, doing sports at school or playing computer games?
part1.zh: 你觉得哪种对健康更好，在学校运动还是玩电脑游戏？

part1.en: I think doing sports at school is definitely better because you move your body and it's also a good way to make friends.
part1.zh: 我觉得在学校运动肯定更好，因为你能活动身体，而且也是交朋友的好途径。

part2.prompt: 描述一张关于运动的照片：说说照片里有谁、在哪里、在做什么、可能的心情。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see two children playing football in a park.
sentences.zh: 在照片里，我看到两个孩子在公园里踢足球。

sentences.en: There is also a woman, maybe their mother, sitting on a bench and watching them.
sentences.zh: 还有一个女人，可能是他们的妈妈，坐在长凳上看着他们。

sentences.en: The boy in a red T-shirt is kicking the ball, while the girl is trying to stop it.
sentences.zh: 穿红色T恤的男孩正在踢球，而女孩正试图拦住球。

sentences.en: It looks like a sunny day because the sky is clear and there are some trees with green leaves.
sentences.zh: 看起来是晴天，因为天空晴朗，还有一些长着绿叶的树木。

sentences.en: They probably enjoy the game very much, and the woman looks relaxed and happy.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能很享受这场比赛，而那位女士看起来轻松又开心。

sentences.en: I think spending time outdoors like this is a great way to stay active and have fun.
sentences.zh: 我认为像这样在户外活动是保持活力和享受乐趣的好方法。

title: 聊聊季节与天气
subtitle: Weather and seasons
examTip: 这个话题在PET口语Part 1中，考官常会提问个人偏好与经历，例如你喜欢哪个季节、不同天气通常做什么、你的家乡气候如何。回答时不能只说一个词，需用完整句给出理由或例子，比如用'because...'解释原因，或用'when it's... I usually...'描述习惯。在Part 2，你会看到一张彩色照片，通常展示人们在某种天气或季节里的活动，你需要连续说大约1分钟。描述时要先整体说'In the picture...'，然后讲人物、地点、动作，用现在进行时，如'He is wearing...'。推测天气或心情时，自然会用到'It looks like...'、'probably'、'I think...'等表达。要特别注意连接词如'so'、'and'、'but'、'also'，使描述更连贯。B1级别学生容易只说简单句，务必扩展句子，例如加上比较或个人感受。

templates.en: When it's ___, I like to ___.
templates.zh: 描述特定天气下喜欢做的事

templates.en: I prefer ___ weather because ___.
templates.zh: 表达天气偏好并给出理由

templates.en: In my hometown, it usually ___ in summer.
templates.zh: 描述家乡的典型气候

templates.en: One thing I enjoy doing on a ___ day is ___.
templates.zh: 说一种天气下享受的活动

part1.en: What's your favourite season? Why?
part1.zh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？为什么？

part1.en: My favourite season is spring because the weather is warm and flowers bloom.
part1.zh: 我最喜欢春天，因为天气温暖，鲜花盛开。

part1.en: What do you usually do when it's rainy?
part1.zh: 下雨的时候你通常做什么？

part1.en: When it's rainy, I usually stay at home and read a book or watch a film.
part1.zh: 下雨的时候，我通常待在家里读书或看电影。

part1.en: What's the weather like in your hometown in summer?
part1.zh: 你家乡夏天的天气怎么样？

part1.en: In my hometown, summer is usually hot and humid, so I often go swimming to cool down.
part1.zh: 在我的家乡，夏天通常又热又潮湿，所以我经常去游泳降温。

part1.en: Do you prefer hot or cold weather? Why?
part1.zh: 你更喜欢热天还是冷天？为什么？

part1.en: I prefer cold weather because I enjoy wearing warm clothes and drinking hot chocolate. Also, I like snow.
part1.zh: 我更喜欢冷天，因为我喜欢穿暖和衣服、喝热巧克力。而且，我喜欢雪。

part2.prompt: 描述一张关于天气的照片：说说照片里有谁、在哪里、在做什么、天气如何、可能的心情。

sentences.en: In the picture, there are two children playing in a park.
sentences.zh: 照片里有两个孩子在公园玩耍。

sentences.en: They are wearing light jackets and scarves, so it looks like it's autumn.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着薄外套和围巾，所以看起来是秋天。

sentences.en: The sky is grey and there are some leaves falling.
sentences.zh: 天空灰蒙蒙的，有些树叶在飘落。

sentences.en: The children are laughing and running, so they seem very happy.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在笑在跑，所以他们看起来很开心。

sentences.en: I think they are probably enjoying the cool weather.
sentences.zh: 我想他们很可能在享受凉爽的天气。

sentences.en: It reminds me of my childhood when I used to play outside in autumn.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起自己的童年，那时我常在秋天到外面玩。

title: 我的电影与音乐品味
subtitle: My taste in movies and music
examTip: 在PET口语Part 1中，考官会就电影与音乐话题提问，例如你喜欢的电影类型、近期看过的电影、是否喜欢在影院看电影、喜欢的音乐类型、是否会演奏乐器等。通常需要用完整句回答，并给出理由或例子。Part 2中，可能会给出一张与娱乐活动相关的彩色照片，要求考生描述照片内容，通常会自然用到现在进行时、There be句型、推测性语言如maybe/probably等。B1级别考生要注意运用连接词（because, so, but, also）使回答更连贯，尽量拓展1-2句话，避免只答yes/no。描述照片时要组织好逻辑，先说整体场景，再描述人物动作和可能的心情，最后可加入个人观点。

templates.en: I enjoy watching ___ films because they are ___.
templates.zh: 说喜欢的电影类型

templates.en: I prefer ___ to ___ because it’s more ___.
templates.zh: 比较两种娱乐方式

templates.en: One of my favourite songs is ___ by ___; it makes me feel ___.
templates.zh: 分享最喜欢的歌曲

templates.en: I used to play the ___, but now I ___.
templates.zh: 谈论乐器学习经历

part1.en: What kind of films do you usually watch?
part1.zh: 你通常看什么类型的电影？

part1.en: I usually watch comedies because they make me laugh and help me relax after a long day.
part1.zh: 我通常看喜剧，因为它们让我笑，帮助我在漫长的一天后放松。

part1.en: Do you prefer watching films at the cinema or at home?
part1.zh: 你更喜欢在电影院还是在家看电影？

part1.en: I prefer watching films at home. It's more comfortable, and I can pause the film whenever I want.
part1.zh: 我更喜欢在家看电影。这样更舒服，而且我可以随时暂停。

part1.en: Have you ever been to a live music concert?
part1.zh: 你曾经去过现场音乐会吗？

part1.en: Yes, I have. I went to a pop concert last summer. It was amazing because the atmosphere was so exciting.
part1.zh: 是的，我去过。去年夏天我去了一场流行音乐会。那次体验很棒，因为现场气氛非常热烈。

part1.en: Can you play any musical instruments?
part1.zh: 你会演奏任何乐器吗？

part1.en: I used to play the piano, but I stopped a few years ago. Now I’m thinking about learning the guitar.
part1.zh: 我以前弹钢琴，但几年前停了。现在我在考虑学吉他。

part2.prompt: 描述一张关于娱乐的照片：说说照片里有什么人、他们在哪里、在做什么、以及他们可能的心情。

sentences.en: In the picture, there are two friends sitting on a sofa in a cosy living room.
sentences.zh: 在照片中，两个朋友坐在舒适客厅的沙发上。

sentences.en: They are watching a movie on a large TV screen and the room is quite dark, so it looks like a cinema experience at home.
sentences.zh: 他们正在一个大电视屏幕上看电影，房间很暗，所以看起来像是在家的影院体验。

sentences.en: The girl on the left is holding a bowl of popcorn and the boy is pointing at the screen, probably because something funny is happening.
sentences.zh: 左边的女孩拿着一碗爆米花，男孩指着屏幕，可能是因为发生了有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Both of them are laughing, so they seem to be enjoying the film very much.
sentences.zh: 他们两个都在笑，所以他们似乎非常享受这部电影。

sentences.en: I think they chose a comedy because they both look really happy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们选了一部喜剧，因为他们俩看起来都很开心。

sentences.en: There is some popcorn on the table, so it looks like they are having a fun movie night together.
sentences.zh: 桌上有一些爆米花，看起来他们正在享受一个愉快的电影之夜。

title: 手机与生活
subtitle: Phones and the Internet
examTip: 在PET口语Part 1中，考官通常会问及日常手机使用习惯、常用应用、上网的好处与问题等。考生需用完整句回答，并主动给出原因或例子，例如说明为何常用某个应用。Part 2的彩色照片常呈现人们在不同场景使用手机或上网，考生要按顺序清楚描述人物、地点、动作和可能的情绪，连接词如because, so, but, also会自然用到。B1级考生可以根据内容自然使用一般现在时谈习惯、现在进行时描述照片中的动作，也可以在谈经历时用一般过去时或现在完成时。重点不是硬套语法，而是把人物、地点、动作和原因说清楚。

templates.en: I usually use my phone to ___ because it's convenient.
templates.zh: 表达日常用手机做什么并说明原因

templates.en: My favourite app is ___, which I use for ___.
templates.zh: 介绍最常用的应用及其用途

templates.en: One good thing about the Internet is that ___.
templates.zh: 说明网络的一个好处

templates.en: I think it's important to ___ so that we don't ___.
templates.zh: 表达如何平衡上网与生活

part1.en: How often do you use your mobile phone?
part1.zh: 你多久用一次手机？

part1.en: I use it every day, especially for checking messages and social media. I think it's part of my daily routine.
part1.zh: 我每天都用，尤其是查看信息和社交媒体。我觉得这是我日常生活的一部分。

part1.en: Do you have a favourite app? Why do you like it?
part1.zh: 你有一个最喜欢的应用吗？你为什么喜欢它？

part1.en: Yes, I really like a video-sharing app because I can learn new things and relax by watching clips. It's very entertaining.
part1.zh: 是的，我很喜欢一个视频分享应用，因为我可以学新东西并通过看短片放松。它很有趣。

part1.en: What are the good things about the Internet?
part1.zh: 互联网有什么好处？

part1.en: The Internet helps me keep in touch with friends and find information quickly. Also, online learning has become much easier.
part1.zh: 互联网帮我与朋友保持联系并快速查找信息。而且，在线学习也变得更容易了。

part1.en: Have you ever had a problem with your phone or the Internet?
part1.zh: 你的手机或上网时遇到过问题吗？

part1.en: I once forgot my phone at home and felt really lost. It showed me how much I depend on it.
part1.zh: 有一次我把手机忘在家里，感觉非常失落。这让我意识到我有多依赖它。

part2.prompt: 描述一张关于使用手机的照片：说说照片里有谁、在哪里、在做什么、可能的心情。

sentences.en: In the picture, there is a teenage girl sitting on a bench in a park.
sentences.zh: 照片里，有一个十几岁的女孩坐在公园的长椅上。

sentences.en: She is holding her smartphone and smiling at the screen.
sentences.zh: 她正拿着智能手机，对着屏幕微笑。

sentences.en: There are some trees and flowers around her, so the place looks pleasant and relaxing.
sentences.zh: 她周围有一些树和花，所以这个地方看起来很舒适、很放松。

sentences.en: She seems to be chatting with her friends because she is typing quickly.
sentences.zh: 她似乎在和朋友聊天，因为她打字很快。

sentences.en: I think she is enjoying the conversation and might feel happy to keep in touch with her friends.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她很享受这次聊天，也可能因为能和朋友保持联系而感到开心。

sentences.en: It looks like using a phone outdoors can be relaxing.
sentences.zh: 看起来在户外使用手机可以很放松。

title: 未来工作畅想
subtitle: My Future Career
examTip: 在 PET 口语 Part 1 中，考官通常会问及你的未来职业理想、原因，以及你做过的兼职或家务。你需要用完整句回答，并自然给出理由和例子，比如用 because 或 so 解释。Part 2 会给你一张彩色照片，上面可能有人在工作或做家务。你需要用约 1 分钟描述照片中的人物、地点、动作、物品和可能的心情。最后可以用一句简单的个人看法收尾，但重点仍然是照片本身。

templates.en: I would like to be a ___ because I enjoy ___.
templates.zh: 表达理想职业及原因

templates.en: I've helped at home or at school. For example, I ___.
templates.zh: 介绍在家或学校帮过的忙

templates.en: Helping with housework like ___ makes me feel ___.
templates.zh: 说明做家务的感受

templates.en: In the future, I’m going to ___ so that I can ___.
templates.zh: 说出未来计划及目的

part1.en: Examiner: What job would you like to do in the future?
part1.zh: 考官：你将来想做什么工作？

part1.en: Candidate: I want to be a graphic designer because I’m creative and I love art.
part1.zh: 考生：我想当一名平面设计师，因为我有创意而且热爱艺术。

part1.en: Examiner: Why do you think that job is interesting?
part1.zh: 考官：你为什么觉得那份工作有趣？

part1.en: Candidate: I think it’s more exciting than an office job, and I can use my imagination every day.
part1.zh: 考生：我觉得这比办公室工作更刺激，而且每天都能发挥想象力。

part1.en: Examiner: Have you ever done any part-time work or helped at home?
part1.zh: 考官：你做过兼职或在家帮过忙吗？

part1.en: Candidate: Yes, I’ve worked as a waiter in a local restaurant. It was tiring but I learned to be patient.
part1.zh: 考生：是的，我在当地一家餐厅做过服务员。虽然很累，但我学会了耐心。

part1.en: Examiner: What chores do you do at home?
part1.zh: 考官：你在家做什么家务？

part1.en: Candidate: I often wash the dishes and clean my room, so my parents are happier.
part1.zh: 考生：我经常洗碗和打扫自己的房间，这样父母会更开心。

part2.prompt: 描述一张关于工作的照片：说说照片里有谁、在哪里、在做什么、可能的心情，以及你由此联想到的自己的未来工作。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a young woman working in a bright modern kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在照片里，我可以看到一个年轻女子在一个明亮的现代厨房里工作。

sentences.en: She is wearing a chef’s uniform and she’s decorating a cake on a table.
sentences.zh: 她穿着厨师制服，正在桌上装饰一个蛋糕。

sentences.en: There are some bowls, fresh fruit and a rolling pin near her.
sentences.zh: 她旁边有一些碗、新鲜水果和一根擀面杖。

sentences.en: She seems calm and focused because she is looking carefully at the cake.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很平静、很专注，因为她正认真地看着蛋糕。

sentences.en: Maybe she loves her job as a pastry chef and feels proud of her work.
sentences.zh: 也许她热爱自己作为糕点师的工作，并为此感到自豪。

sentences.en: I think I would also enjoy a creative job like this in the future.
sentences.zh: 我觉得将来我也愿意从事这样有创意的工作。

title: 温馨一家人
subtitle: Family and friends
examTip: 在PET口语考试中，家庭与朋友是高频话题。Part 1考官通常会问家里有谁、和谁最亲、周末和朋友做什么等，B1考生需用完整句回答并自然给出理由或例子，比如用because、so、also等连接词拓展。Part 2会给一张彩色照片，可能展示家庭聚餐或朋友游玩场景，考生需要描述照片里有谁、在哪、做什么、可能的心情，通常会自然用到现在进行时、There is/are、It looks like…等结构，并适当用maybe、probably、I think等词进行推测。注意回答时避免只蹦单词，要连贯表达，多给细节，展现B1级别的沟通能力。

templates.en: There are ___ people in my family, including ___.
templates.zh: 用来介绍家庭成员的数量和构成。

templates.en: I'm closest to ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 说明和哪位家人最亲近并给出原因。

templates.en: At weekends, we usually ___ together.
templates.zh: 描述周末全家常一起进行的活动。

templates.en: My best friend and I enjoy ___ when we meet.
templates.zh: 分享和好友见面时喜欢做的事。

part1.en: How many people are there in your family?
part1.zh: 你家有几口人？

part1.en: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger sister and me. We all live together in a flat.
part1.zh: 我家有四口人：我父母、妹妹和我。我们都住在一间公寓里。

part1.en: Who are you closest to in your family?
part1.zh: 你和家里谁最亲？

part1.en: I'm closest to my mum because she always listens to me and gives me good advice. We often go shopping together.
part1.zh: 我和妈妈最亲，因为她总是听我倾诉并给我好建议。我们经常一起去购物。

part1.en: What do you usually do with your friends at weekends?
part1.zh: 你通常和朋友在周末做什么？

part1.en: We usually meet at the sports centre. We play badminton or sometimes just hang out and chat.
part1.zh: 我们通常在体育中心见面。我们打羽毛球，有时就只是聚在一起聊聊天。

part1.en: Do you prefer spending weekends with your family or friends?
part1.zh: 你更喜欢和家人还是朋友一起度周末？

part1.en: I enjoy both, but I think I prefer spending time with my family because we don't see each other much during the week. Also, we have a lot of fun cooking together.
part1.zh: 我都喜欢，但我认为我更喜欢和家人在一起，因为平时我们见面不多。而且，我们一起做饭很有趣。

part2.prompt: 描述一张关于全家出游的照片：说说照片里有谁、在哪里、在做什么、他们可能的心情。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a family having a picnic in a park.
sentences.zh: 在这张照片里，我看到一家人在公园里野餐。

sentences.en: A mother and a father are sitting on a blanket, and they are smiling.
sentences.zh: 一位妈妈和一位爸爸正坐在毯子上，他们在微笑。

sentences.en: A young girl is running after a small dog, and she looks very excited.
sentences.zh: 一个小女孩在追一只小狗，她看上去非常兴奋。

sentences.en: The sun is shining, so it's probably a warm summer day.
sentences.zh: 阳光明媚，所以这很可能是一个温暖的夏日。

sentences.en: I think they are all feeling happy and relaxed because they are spending time together.
sentences.zh: 我想他们都很开心、放松，因为他们在一起享受时光。

sentences.en: Maybe they have brought some food with them, because there is a basket next to them.
sentences.zh: 也许他们带了一些食物，因为旁边有一个篮子。
